business_problem: Revolut needed to replace siloed fraud, credit, recommendation, and engagement models with a shared behavioral-intelligence layer, because hand-built features and separate models slowed experimentation, increased infrastructure cost, and limited the company's ability to adapt quickly across products and markets.
solution_summary: Revolut trained PRAGMA, a family of foundation models for financial behavior, on NVIDIA accelerated computing so one shared embedding backbone could support risk, growth, and product workloads. The architecture tokenizes customer profiles, transaction events, and time signals into a unified representation, then enriches merchant text with NVIDIA Llama-Nemotron-Embed-1B-v2. Training and serving run on NVIDIA H100 GPUs in Nebius AI Cloud, with sequence packing, dynamic batching, and attention kernels increasing throughput and making large pretraining runs practical within fixed time and cost windows. Teams can either freeze the model and attach lightweight heads or apply LoRA fine-tuning for new use cases, avoiding repeated feature-engineering cycles. This turned PRAGMA into a reusable AI layer for credit risk, fraud, and product recommendation systems, giving Revolut a single model family that scales across geographies and business lines while improving accuracy and engineering speed.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA H100 GPUs
solution_components.role: Power large-scale pretraining and optimized inference for Revolut's PRAGMA models.

solution_components.name: Nebius AI Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the accelerated training environment used for PRAGMA development and refreshes.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Llama-Nemotron-Embed-1B-v2
solution_components.role: Embeds merchant descriptions and other unstructured text fields into the behavioral model.

data_flow: Customer attributes, transaction streams, and merchant text are encoded into PRAGMA's shared behavioral representation on NVIDIA infrastructure, then reused by downstream fraud, credit, recommendation, and engagement models through frozen embeddings or LoRA-tuned adapters.
business_outcome: Revolut cut model-development cycles by 3–5x, increased training throughput by 2–5x, improved credit-default detection by 2.3x, raised fraud recall by 64.7% while improving fraud precision by 16.7%, and made recommendations 41% more relevant with one reusable foundation-model backbone.
metrics: 2.3× better accuracy at identifying credit default risk
architecture_clues: PRAGMA combines separate encoders for user attributes, events, and long-term history.
Revolut uses sequence packing and dynamic batching to maximize H100 utilization.
Teams reuse PRAGMA through frozen embeddings or LoRA fine-tuning instead of rebuilding features from scratch.
